scenes.title_en: Leaf Shutter Sits in the Lens
scenes.context: 镜间快门顾名思义在镜头中间、光圈旁，其结构和光圈也有些相似。由于其在镜头内部，开合的过程中CMOS可以整体感光，不存在时间差，因此也就不会产生果冻效应，其开合速度通常也更快。
sentences: 镜间快门在镜头中间、光圈旁。
The leaf shutter lives in the lens, next to the aperture.
开合时CMOS整体感光，没有时间差。
The whole sensor exposes at once, with no time gap.
因此不会产生果冻效应，开合还更快。
No rolling shutter, and faster speeds to boot.
scenes.speak: The leaf shutter lives in the lens, next to the aperture. The whole sensor exposes at once, with no time gap. No rolling shutter, and faster speeds to boot.

scenes.context: 缺点就是会对进光量和景深有影响，对硬件的要求也很高，结构复杂，所以这种快门的应用并不常见。其实所有类型的快门本质上都是一个开关，一个控制时间的开关，其目的就是让相机更精确地还原我们按下快门的那一刻，这个世界最真实的模样。
sentences: 缺点：影响进光量和景深，硬件要求高。
Downsides: it affects light and depth, and needs costly hardware.
所有快门本质上都是控制时间的开关。
Every shutter is really just a switch that controls time.
scenes.speak: Downsides: it affects light and depth, and needs costly hardware. So it's rarely seen. Every shutter is really just a switch that controls time.

practice: The leaf shutter lives inside the lens, right next to the aperture blades.
The whole sensor exposes at once, so there's no rolling shutter.
Every shutter is just a switch that controls how long light gets in.
pitfalls: Confuse the leaf shutter with the focal plane.
A leaf shutter is in the lens; the focal plane one sits at the sensor.
镜间快门在镜头里，焦平面快门在机身。
Its cost and light trade-offs keep it rare on modern bodies.
成本高影响进光，应用不常见。
It avoids rolling distortion, but motion blur still depends on time.
免的是果冻效应，不是运动模糊。
It steals a bit of depth-of-field control and max light.
它会影响进光量和景深。
shifts: 用 leaf shutter（镜间快门）、focal plane shutter（焦平面快门）、rolling shutter（果冻效应）
用 aperture blades（光圈叶片）、open fully（整体开启）、no time gap（无时间差）
